lastCompletedStory.title: Wire cam journal archive [--threshold N] CLI subcommand

nextStoryContext: `cam journal archive [--threshold N]` is now wired in index.ts alongside `cam journal append`: ParsedJournalArgs is a 3-member discriminated union (`append` | `archive` | help:true); parseJournalArgs('archive', ...) always resolves a concrete threshold (default mirrors journal-archive.ts's exported `DEFAULT_THRESHOLD` = 50, imported aliased as JOURNAL_ARCHIVE_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD to avoid a duplicated magic number) and rejects a non-positive-integer or missing --threshold value with printFatalHint + null (usage error, exit 1 at the call site). dispatchJournal branches on mode==='archive' BEFORE the stdin read (append is still the only stdin path) via an injectable `archiveFn?: (threshold: number) => ArchiveJournalOnMainResult` dep on JournalDispatchDeps, defaulting to a real archiveJournalOnMain call with process.cwd() + a real spawnSync wrapper (same pattern as appendFn's default). Printed sentinels: success 'CAM_JOURNAL_ARCHIVED=<k> sha=<sha>' (exit 0), below-threshold no-op 'CAM_JOURNAL_ARCHIVE=noop entries=<n> threshold=<t>' (exit 0), failure exit 1 (no sentinel; archiveJournalOnMain already printError'd internally). JOURNAL_HELP's usage line and the top-level `cam --help` command list both literally contain 'journal archive [--threshold N]'. US-003 (auto-invoke the archive check on the --cycle-close path) should call archiveJournalOnMain directly (or dispatchJournal's archive path) from within the --cycle-close branch of dispatchJournal in index.ts, AFTER the append+handoff+marker sequence succeeds -- do not block the existing append sentinel/exit-code contract (exit 3/4 codes stay reserved for the handoff/watcher guards already there). US-004 (replace the manual archive rule in templates and agent file) should grep scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md and any templates/ copy for the old manual-archive prose and point it at the new `cam journal archive` subcommand instead -- remember templates/ + .claude/ dual-copy means editing scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md alone will NOT auto-propagate to templates/ (see cam-dual-copy-is-per-file pattern); check whether embed-vendor:check flags anything.
